headline: CARICOM Central Bankers Cite Energy Shocks and Demographics as Key Risks
summary: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago Governor Larry Howai highlighted global energy shocks, economic diversification, ageing populations, and emigration as critical challenges confronting Caribbean economies during a CARICOM central bank meeting in Belize.
why: Small island developing economies across the Caribbean face heightened vulnerability to commodity price volatility and demographic shifts, shaping regional monetary and fiscal policies.
